headline: Southwest Baptist share fifteen goals among seven scorers
dek: Two matches into the season, Southwest Baptist have not conceded a goal, and no other programme has scored as many as they have. Nathaniel Velasquez has three of them, with an assist, from ten shots.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: In two matches Southwest Baptist have outscored more than half the conference put together: Lewis, Lincoln, Maryville, Illinois Springfield, Indianapolis, McKendree, Missouri-St. Louis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell have fewer goals between them.

wire.line: Southwest Baptist have won both matches without conceding and open conference play at home to Missouri-St. Louis.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven matches are score gaps, finals with no published score, and all seven are dated before the earliest published result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Missouri S&T have won both their matches, scoring seven and conceding once, and the one match past its date with no published result is theirs, away at Kentucky Wesleyan.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Upper Iowa have drawn both their matches, scoring once and conceding once, and play in the conference's opening match, away at Missouri S&T.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rockhurst have conceded ten goals, more than any other programme, and their two defeats have come at Fort Hays State and at home to Rogers State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Indianapolis have scored once and conceded once across a win, a draw and a defeat; Rick Lammerts has made eight saves and been beaten once.

last_match.line: Rogers State leave having beaten McKendree, Maryville and Rockhurst in turn; Rockhurst have now conceded more goals than any programme in the conference.

next_match.line: McKendree have lost both their matches by a single goal; Cedarville opened with a goalless draw against Indianapolis.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
